newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrobudowa 96-98 nets up - IB Austria.
newsitem.headline: Elektrobudowa 96-98 nets up - IB Austria.

text.p: Polish construction company Elektrobudowa SA should lift net profit to 13.8 million zlotys this year and 17.4 million zlotys next year from 8.4 million zlotys in 1995, IB Austria Securities in Warsaw said.
IB Austria said in a report dated November 6 that Elektrobudowa should net 21.5 million zlotys in 1998.
It said Elektrobudowa's sales were likely to grow to 215 million zlotys, 280 million and 350 million in 1996, 1997 and 1998 respectively from last year's 168.4 million zlotys.
IB Austria's net profit forecast for this year is higher than that of Elektrobudowa, which has said it expects to earn 13.3 million zlotys in 1996.
Elektrobudowa has not yet presented a forecast for 1997 and 1998.
